title: Capstone: Ship a Business-Ready Agent
brief: Ship one agent you would put in front of a business team, and defend it.
This re-checks the work from Labs 7 through 11 in one pass: curated objects, a
configured agent, a knowledge store, example queries and instructions, and a benchmark
with ground truth. Run check_lab for each of those first; this one is the assembly.
Then write the handover: who owns it, what it does not answer, what breaks it, and
how someone would know it had started being wrong.
